name: Qing Hua Holding Group Company Limited
summary: Yeah Yeah Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company established in 2001 and headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, operates across diverse sectors including media and entertainment, and funeral services. Its services extend to Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, and Taiwan. The company's media and entertainment division actively invests in and produces concert, film, and television drama projects, along with other entertainment events and musical performances. This segment also manages music intellectual property rights, handles talent representation, provides platform solutions, and offers stage production services, in addition to holding a club membership. Within the funeral services domain, the group delivers pet aftercare, administrative support, and the sale of related merchandise, alongside comprehensive cremation, funeral, and various other death care services. The company adopted its current name, Yeah Yeah Group Holdings Limited, in July 2022, having previously been known as Sun Entertainment Group Limited.
